embeddings.text: A personal loan is granted to an individual aged 21 to 65 at the time of application.
The loan amount is between 5,000 and 120,000 ILS and the repayment term is between 6 and 72 months.

The applicant must have been employed for at least 6 months with the current employer, or self-employed for at least 18 months. Applicants aged 18 and above who have been employed for at least 24 months are also eligible. Unemployed applicants are not eligible.
Net monthly income must be at least 7,000 ILS. For self-employed applicants the average of the last 12 months is used.
The monthly installment is computed with an annuity schedule at an annual interest rate of 10.8%.

The debt-to-income ratio, defined as existing monthly repayments plus the new installment divided by net monthly income, must not exceed 45%. Applications with a ratio between 40% and 45% are referred to an underwriter.

An applicant with two or more adverse credit events in the last 24 months is rejected. An applicant with exactly one event must provide a guarantor with a reasonable repayment history; without a guarantor the application is referred.
Applications that meet every condition above are approved. Anything not decided by the rules above is referred for manual review.

R-010 · Monthly installment at 10.8% annual interest
When: always
Then: set monthly_installment = round(requested_amount × 0.009 / (1 − pow(1.009, 0 − term_months)), 2)
Source, paragraph 5: "The monthly installment is computed with an annuity schedule at an annual interest rate of 10.8%"

R-020 · Debt-to-income ratio
When: monthly_income > 0 ILS
Then: set debt_to_income = round((existing_monthly_debt + monthly_installment) / monthly_income, 4)
Source, paragraph 6: "existing monthly repayments plus the new installment divided by net monthly income"

R-100 · Reject: younger than 21
When: age < 21 years
Then: reject: The applicant is younger than the minimum age of 21
Source, paragraph 1: "aged 21 to 65 at the time of application"

R-110 · Reject: older than 65
When: age > 65 years
Then: reject: The applicant is older than the maximum age of 65
Source, paragraph 1: "aged 21 to 65 at the time of application"

R-120 · Reject: amount outside 5,000 to 120,000
When: NOT [requested_amount [5,000 ILS .. 120,000 ILS]]
Then: reject: The loan amount must be between 5,000 and 120,000 ILS
Source, paragraph 2: "The loan amount is between 5,000 and 120,000 ILS"

R-130 · Reject: term outside 6 to 72 months
When: NOT [term_months [6 months .. 72 months]]
Then: reject: The repayment term must be between 6 and 72 months
Source, paragraph 2: "the repayment term is between 6 and 72 months"

R-140 · Reject: unemployed
When: employment_type = unemployed
Then: reject: Unemployed applicants are not eligible
Source, paragraph 3: "Unemployed applicants are not eligible"

R-150 · Reject: employed for less than 6 months
When: employment_type = salaried AND employment_months < 6 months
Then: reject: At least 6 months with the current employer are required
Source, paragraph 3: "employed for at least 6 months with the current employer"

R-160 · Reject: self-employed for less than 18 months
When: employment_type = self_employed AND employment_months < 18 months
Then: reject: At least 18 months of self-employment are required
Source, paragraph 3: "self-employed for at least 18 months"

R-170 · Reject: net income below 7,000
When: monthly_income < 7,000 ILS
Then: reject: Net monthly income is below the minimum of 7,000 ILS
Source, paragraph 4: "Net monthly income must be at least 7,000 ILS"

R-200 · Reject: debt-to-income above 45%
When: debt_to_income > 0.45
Then: reject: The debt-to-income ratio exceeds 45%
Source, paragraph 6: "must not exceed 45%"

R-220 · Reject: two or more adverse credit events
When: credit_events_24m ≥ 2
Then: reject: Two or more adverse credit events in the last 24 months
Source, paragraph 7: "An applicant with two or more adverse credit events in the last 24 months is rejected"

R-320 · Underwriter: ratio between 40% and 45%
When: debt_to_income [0.4 .. 0.45]
Then: refer: A debt-to-income ratio between 40% and 45% requires an underwriter
Source, paragraph 6: "Applications with a ratio between 40% and 45% are referred to an underwriter"

R-330 · Referral: one credit event without a guarantor
When: credit_events_24m = 1 AND has_guarantor = false
Then: refer: One adverse credit event requires a guarantor
Source, paragraph 7: "without a guarantor the application is referred"

R-900 · Approve: every condition is met
When: always
Then: approve: The application meets every condition of the policy
Source, paragraph 8: "Applications that meet every condition above are approved"
